ns2:course.label: Composition
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 306) Work in original composition including small and large forms. Students submit scores of their compositions to the composition faculty in order to obtain consent to register; consent is granted on the basis of the quality of the music the student has composed and the level of skill demonstrated in the work submitted. Prerequisite: For undergraduates, MUS 301, MUS 302, and MUS 206 and consent of composition faculty; for graduate students, consent of composition faculty.
